title: Lights, Camera, Algorithm: AI’s Role in Modern Filmmaking
description: Artificial intelligence revolutionizes filmmaking with script analysis, visual effects, and personalized content, streamlining production.
short_description: A grounded look at AI in filmmaking, covering what works, what wobbles, and what matters in practice.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: A clear, no-hype briefing on AI in filmmaking for creators, producers, editors, and readers tracking how tools reshape creative work.
